verdict.rationale: Devin's core product surface is exactly this: users delegate coding tasks via web app, Slack/Teams, terminal, or IDE, and Devin executes autonomously (devin-docs-1, devin-docs-4, devin-docs-5, devin-docs-3, devin-docs-2). First-party docs are extensive and detailed, covering multiple delegation channels and interactive handoff. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of consistent task delegation success (community evidence like devin-comm-2 flags a low ~13.8% resolution rate on benchmark tasks, tempering confidence in reliability though not disputing the delegation feature itself).
